title: City Leadership Roles & Affordability Revamp
summary:
*   **New Committee Assignments:** Austin is shaking up its internal leadership, with council members confirming their roles on various city committees and intergovernmental entities for the year.
*   **Revitalizing Affordability Efforts:** A key focus was reigniting the Regional Affordability Committee to tackle issues like housing, transportation, childcare, and workforce wages holistically.
*   **Role Shifts & Openings:** Specific changes discussed include new vice-chair appointments, a council member joining Public Safety, and an open spot on the Public Health Committee. A request to join the Audit and Finance Committee as a voting member was also debated.
*   **No Action on Planning Commission:** A listed item concerning Planning Commission appointments was mistakenly added to the agenda and was not discussed or acted upon.
